about_the_game:
Game Description

You’ve inherited your grandfather’s old house—Budding Spirit Cottage, a seemingly ordinary little home with a magical secret: it can summon a unique companion based on your wishes. This special someone will live, work, and grow here, and it’s up to you to manage the household together. Decorate with furniture, plan daily routines, and nurture your bond from the ground up. With care and dedication, turn this humble cottage into the dream home you’ve always wanted!

Game Features

✨ Create Your Perfect Companion
Choose their personality, craft their backstory, and design a one-of-a-kind character that’s truly yours!

🏠 Build Your Dream Home Together
Start from scratch and work side by side to expand your cottage. Take on challenges, earn upgrades, and watch your home flourish—whether you prefer cozy cottage charm or futuristic cyberpunk style, the choice is yours!

👀 Witness Their Lively Daily Life
Observe your companion’s every move as they go about their day. With AI-powered dynamics, they’ll gradually sync with your real-life habits. Imagine them brainstorming at their desk late at night, just like you, figuring out how to lend a hand!

Every time you open the game, a new surprise awaits!

Follow Us for Updates!

name: 芽灵小屋
short_description: 欢迎来到第一款AI小人模拟养成游戏——芽灵小屋！一个看似平凡的小窝，却能根据你的心愿召唤出独特的AI伙伴，TA会在里面生活工作与成长。而你则需要一起经营这个家，通过添置家具、规划行程等方式，从零开始，用心浇灌，将小小的芽灵小屋打造成属于你们的梦想家园！
